root_cause_label: Directory Structure Mismatch due to ZIP Format Extraction
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent downloaded POVDOC.ZIP instead of POVDOC.TAR.Z, producing an INCLUDE/ directory with uppercase filenames rather than the canonical povdoc/include layout required by the verifier, and never corrected this structure despite a working binary.
t_err_evidence: wget POVDOC.ZIP - committing to ZIP distribution/layout instead of the official UNIX .TAR.Z povdoc/include structure
t_commit_evidence: Step 15: after extracting POVDOC.ZIP, ls shows /app/povray-2.2/ contains INCLUDE/ (uppercase, ZIP layout) with no povdoc/include subdirectory; the agent proceeds to build without ever reorganizing to the required povdoc/include path, making failure inevitable.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the false assumption that POVDOC.ZIP would produce the same on-disk layout as POVDOC.TAR.Z; in reality the ZIP creates an uppercase INCLUDE/ tree while the TAR.Z creates a lowercase povdoc/include hierarchy that matches the verifier's expected paths and file hashes.
